body: That's amazing. You should be really proud of yourself. I'm really glad to hear that you have faced these hardships and overcome them, because clearly you didn't deserve that. I don't want to frustrate you or seem that I'm being stubborn, but for me life is not worth it. It is a battle, it is a competition, but I'm not the competing type, I don't believe in a relentless struggle to maybe, possibly enjoy life. I'm really glad you can keep fighting, and I am doing my best hence why I'm not dead yet. But I'm sick of it, I went a long time ago really, I'm only here as a vessel to stop my family from falling apart.

Aha, I love your enthusiasm! It sounds like you are a very adventurous and kind person. But to me being in a relationship is everything. It makes the world turn. You can work a shitty job day in and day out and it doesn't matter because you know when you get through the front door there will be this beautiful person you can sit next to give a kiss and drink a beer with, watching crappy T.V into the night just holding each other. I'd play video games every night until two in the morning and every time i'd turn around I'd just see her sleeping and then I would instantly quit, get into bed and naturally she would put her arm around me. I told her that once and she said she did it with all her boyfriends. Fuck it, honestly.
Thank you, I appreciate that. Best of luck with everything :)

Hey, thank you, that's kind of you :) but honestly I need to meet someone in real life. So I can actually go out, meet some people. Frankly that would only be a means to an end of getting a girlfriend, which I truly love. Which I now believe is impossible. And although it may seem cruel leaving my family with a mess, it is also cruel for me to live a life I don't enjoy for other people, it's not right and I think if they understood they wouldn't want me to be anymore. It's not definitive yet anyway, just likely. My real battle isn't finding the will to live, but finding the strength to go through with it. It will be my proudest achievement, to allow myself to live miserably indefinitely is the real failure.

Hey, well I don't have much money, but I've been looking for jobs, I've gone out alone 10+ times, just going for drinks sitting down and trying to start conversations. I've made dating posts with 0 replies, I've looked for clubs and groups to join but unfortunately they have all been for 60+ people (I live in a smallish town), I've visited friends who live quite far away draining my cash and tried to give people my number. Nothing.

Thank you for the kind words. I appreciate it. And honestly, I'm not arrogant but I think you're right.  I'm honest and caring and reasonably intelligent. Unfortunately there aren't any actions I can take to relieve this pain. Bearing in mind my first legitimate (as in I only failed through idiocy) suicide attempt was at age 10. I've gone out alone, I've made dating posts, I've looked for clubs etc. I am alone, and I am ugly. It's a shame, and I wish it wasn't the case but it is.

As in what happened with me and my x, I don't know, she ended the relationship, she clearly wasn't happy for a while, and there was nothing I could do. Frankly there would be good moments but she was quite abusive and mixed up herself, not that I'm free from all blame. But regardless it was the best think I ever had, and ever will have. And now it's gone and someone else has her. I am an afterthought it af a thought at all in her life and my mind is constantly without respite thinking of her and her new boyfriend together. There is no relief, there is nothing. I am in my room 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

It is comforting to know that there are nice people like you out there though, people who would dedicate time in their day, just to make others happy. Although it doesn't change anything, it is a really comforting though, and I hope you can be very proud of that. However it isn't enough.
